title: review classifies the risk tier by default and keeps it in round two
body:
Outcome: `krn review` classifies the risk tier by default and a round-two review keeps the round-one tier's roles, so a fix that adds a sensitive path cannot be refused by prior-panel role checks and a manual review cannot forget `--risk-tier`.
Evidence: t-sa7ag03 made `--risk-tier` opt-in because about 18 existing review tests drive the CLI on README.md/src.ts fixtures that classify as low; round two recomputes the tier on the new diff while loadPriorReview requires the same panel roles.
Proof: an observer where round one is low and round two adds a src/flow path, asserting the round-two panel and record; existing review tests pass with classification on by default (fixtures pass `--panel` or touch a medium path).
